## AC re-verification on the implementation tree (HEAD 938e962c5d8)

Every probe re-run literally this session rather than carried forward, after an earlier
ticket in this epic had an AC box ticked before its probe was run.

**AC1 — benchmark provenance and re-derivation. PASS.**
`python measure.py --check` → rc=0, `OK: 1524 pairs ({'lexical': 1431, 'semantic': 93}) over
630 tickets re-derive exactly at cad39ed1289`. The header records
`tickets_sha: cad39ed1289ddb5859c490c2e01612ce1edc1420`. Precise reading of "every pair
carries ids, aliases, titles, description heads": the pair objects carry `a`, `b`, `stratum`,
and the alias / title / `description_head` live in the `corpus` map keyed by those ids
(630 entries, each with all three). Every pair resolves to that metadata; the fixture is
normalized rather than denormalized.

**AC2 — per-stratum recall for all three candidates. PASS.**
Re-ran all three quoted command lines; all 12 numbers match the ADR table at :49-54 exactly.

| candidate | lex r@5 | lex r@10 | sem r@5 | sem r@10 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fts5` | 0.771 | 0.993 | 0.823 | 0.952 |
| `digest` | 0.703 | 0.918 | 0.796 | 0.925 |
| `vector` | 0.763 | 0.972 | 0.876 | 0.973 |

No pooled figure appears anywhere in the ADR; `measure.py` itself prints "strata are reported
separately; a pooled figure is not meaningful here", and :24-28 states why.

**AC3 — one architecture, justified from the semantic stratum, with all six fields. PASS.**
Decision at :105-111 adopts `vector` and justifies it from the semantic stratum at k=5. All
six required items are present under explicit headings: Index path :138, Freshness key :142,
Catch-up rule :148, Embedding model :154, Per-ticket cost :166-177 (a 3-row table plus the
once-per-ticket-version argument), bulk-duplicate artifact :24.

**AC4 — ADR tooling. PASS.** `scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check` rc=0;
`scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` rc=0.

All 4 boxes ticked. `make verify` is running solo on this host; push follows rc=0.
